messages:
anna: PR #842 (docs/sdk-snippets) ready for review. Netlify preview is 404ing on /examples/sdk-auth. Can reviewers take a look? I'd like to merge before EOD today but want to avoid preview conflicts with other doc PRs. Netlify preview: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/12345678 :warning:

deploy-bot: Build failed for deploy 12345678 — status: Failed. Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/12345678#logs

tyler: I can repro the 404 on the preview link. Works on root but the examples path 404s. Can you paste the local steps to reproduce?

anna: repro locally with `yarn docs:start`? For this site we use Docusaurus. Quick steps I run locally:
```
git checkout pr/842
yarn
yarn docs:serve
# open http://localhost:3000/examples/sdk-auth
```

sam: tried that and hit the same 404. Looks like the example page imports an asset with an absolute path `/assets/logo.svg` — should be relative. I pushed a tiny fix to the PR to change to `./assets/logo.svg`.

maria: CI shows link-check failing as well in the `link-check` job. Could be baseUrl in the Netlify preview config — previews sometimes use a different root. Did you add `--base-url` to the build step?

anna: good call. I added `--base-url /` in the docs build flags and pushed. Retrying Netlify deploy now.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for PR 842. Waiting for build.

deploy-bot: Deploy success for PR 842 — preview at https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/examples/sdk-auth :tada:

alex: Nice. I'll give an approval once lint and spellcheck jobs are green. Heads up — docs previews are heavy today so let's adopt a small stagger (15 min) between merges to avoid transient preview collisions.

tyler: ack. I'll wait for CI. If everyone signs off I'll plan to merge at 17:30 PT to keep it within the stagger window.

maria: for reviewers who want to run the same link checks locally quickly (helps avoid flakey CI):
```
pip install link-checker
link-checker http://localhost:3000 --ignore-pattern '/api-docs'
```

sam: ran the above locally, everything passes now. Approved from me. :thumbsup:

anna: thanks all! tagging @alex @tyler for final ok. I'll rebase onto main after the final CI green to keep the commit history clean.

alex: LGTM. Merge when CI ✅. I'll hold the merge until 17:30 PT to respect the stagger schedule — ping me if anything else blocks.
